dedupe_keys.name: leveraging iot data stream for near real time calibration of city scale microscopic traffic simulation

description: Leveraging IoT Data Stream for Near-Real-Time Calibration of City-Scale Microscopic Traffic Simulation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kaveh Khoshkhah, Mozhgan Pourmoradnasseri (ITS Lab, Institute of Computer Science, University of Tartu). This repository includes input and output data of the methodology presented in the paper for generating a calibrated dynamic microscopic traffic simulation. The input data includes the network, initial normalized origin-destination matrix, and hourly traffic counts from stationary city sensors. The output is a 24-hour calibrated microscopic traffic simulation for the city of Tartu, Estonia. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
